summary: Evaluate whether a versioned skill or workflow improves realistic outcomes.

inputs.name: request
inputs.description: Requested outcome, scope, constraints, and operating limits.

inputs.name: work-plan
inputs.description: Dependency graph, work-item acceptance criteria, ownership, and limits.

completion_checks: Cases, baselines, scoring, budgets, and exclusions are fixed before comparing outcomes.
Results separate structural checks, behavioral trials, statistical uncertainty, and untested environments.
failure_modes: Missing required inputs, capability, or authority: blocked; retain a concrete next action.
Contradictory or insufficient evidence: inconclusive; never report an unobserved outcome as passed.
A demonstrated violation of a required condition: failed; preserve reproducible evidence.
